name: vision_ddpm_bad
title: The same DDPM trainer with eight planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_ddpm

expected.defect: the training step never calls optimizer.zero_grad()
expected.why: every update applies the running sum of the epoch's gradients, so the diffusion loss plateaus at a value that looks like a schedule problem
every ResidualBlock carries a Dropout, so all thousand reverse steps are sampled through a randomly thinned network and the samples are worse than the model
expected.gap: ISSUE_RULES 3/MLV301 identifies an eval region as a loop over a LOADER-tagged value or a FunctionDef named (validate|evaluate|val|test|predict|inference). p_sample_loop is neither: it loops over reversed(range(timesteps)) and runs the model a thousand times. A diffusion sampler in train mode is a real defect with no rule shaped for it.

expected.why: a thousand-step autograd graph is built for every sample grid, which is an out-of-memory error on any real image size
expected.gap: same region identification as MLV301, so the missing @torch.no_grad() on the sampler is equally out of reach.

expected.defect: the training loader does not shuffle
expected.why: CIFAR-10 is stored in class order, so every batch is one class and the noise prediction is conditioned on it

expected.defect: the epoch loss is accumulated as a live tensor
expected.why: the autograd graph of every batch is retained until the epoch ends

expected.defect: nothing seeds random, numpy or torch
expected.why: the timestep draw, the noise draw and the initialisation all move, so two runs of the same code give different sample grids

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled instead of its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries the class path and breaks when the file moves

forbidden.why: there is no evaluation loader in this project
the loader is built inside build_loader(), reached only from train() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.step() is still called in every batch
no backward() call is inside a no_grad region
clip_grad_norm_ still sits between backward() and step()
there is no softmax and no CrossEntropyLoss in this project
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the images are still moved to the device and the noise is still allocated with device=
there is no split in this project
every nn.Module subclass still calls super().__init__()
the block lists are still nn.ModuleList instances

gaps.what: GaussianDiffusion stores the beta schedule as plain attributes instead of register_buffer, so .to(device) leaves the schedule on the CPU and the first indexed lookup with a CUDA t raises - and the schedule is absent from every checkpoint
gaps.evidence: diffusion.py:38-44 against the clean twin's register_buffer calls

gaps.what: the EMA shadow is updated before optimizer.step(), so it tracks the previous iteration's weights for ever
